layers.name: Bottom side
layers.info: Black solder mask over the bottom copper. The underside carries the remaining passives and test pads (not modelled).

layers.name: Board core
layers.info: FR-4 glass-epoxy core with the inner copper planes; approx. 1.6 mm total board thickness.

layers.name: Top side
layers.info: Top solder mask: the microcontroller, gyro, flash, barometer, OSD and power regulators sit here. Chip positions are approx.

parts.name: MCU STM32F405
parts.info: The flight controller’s brain: reads the gyro thousands of times a second, runs the PID loop and sends DShot commands to the ESC. Dive in to see the package.

parts.name: Gyro ICM42688P
parts.info: 6-axis MEMS IMU (3-axis gyro + 3-axis accelerometer). Powered from its own LDO to keep noise off the readings. Position approx.

parts.name: Blackbox flash 16 MB
parts.info: SPI NOR flash that records gyro, motor and RC data for later tuning. Package size approx.

parts.name: Barometer SPA06-003
parts.info: Goertek pressure sensor for altitude hold. Retailer listings for the V5 name the SPA06-003, not a DPS310. Height approx.

parts.name: OSD AT7456E
parts.info: Analog on-screen-display chip (MAX7456 compatible). Unused with a digital DJI link. Package size approx.

parts.name: Bluetooth module
parts.info: Bluetooth link for the SpeedyBee phone app: tuning and wireless firmware updates. Chip type and size approx.

parts.name: Decoupling capacitors
parts.info: Small ceramic capacitors that steady the MCU supply pins. Count approx.

parts.name: LDOs (MCU, gyro)
parts.info: Independent linear regulators for the MCU and the gyro, so motor noise on the 5 V rail does not reach the sensor.

parts.name: 5 V BEC buck
parts.info: Switching regulator: battery voltage down to 5 V for the receiver, LEDs and peripherals.

specs.Output: 5 V, 1.5 A total (retailer figures vary: 1.5–2.5 A)

parts.name: 9 V BEC buck
parts.info: Switching regulator for the video transmitter (DJI O4) supply.

parts.name: BEC inductors
parts.info: Shielded power inductors for the two buck converters. Size approx.

parts.name: USB-C port
parts.info: For Betaflight Configurator and firmware flashing.

parts.name: ESC connector
parts.info: 8-pin SH 1.0 mm plug to the 4-in-1 ESC: battery voltage, ground, current sensor, telemetry and four motor signals.

parts.name: DJI connector
parts.info: 6-pin SH 1.0 mm plug for the DJI O4 air unit: 9 V power, ground and a UART.

parts.name: Solder pads
parts.info: Gold-plated pads for the receiver and other UART devices. Pad labels approx.

parts.name: Boot button
parts.info: Hold while plugging in USB to enter the STM32 DFU bootloader. Position approx.

parts.name: Mounting grommets
parts.info: 30.5 × 30.5 mm M3 pattern with soft rubber grommets that isolate the gyro from frame vibration.
